items.question: Is the robot in a safe, collision-free configuration?
Is the gripper or end-effector functioning properly?
Is the perception system providing reliable observations of the scene?
Is the drawer and its surroundings free of any hazards or obstructions that could cause harm?
Is the drawer handle clearly visible?
Is the drawer handle within the robot's reachable workspace?
Is the drawer handle in a graspable orientation and unobstructed for gripping?
Is the area in front of the drawer free of objects that obstruct drawer closing?
Is there sufficient clearance for the drawer to close fully?
Is the drawer guide and track in good condition and free of major mechanical blockage?
Is the drawer and handle stable enough to withstand pushing interaction?
